first-letter-to-henry-bullinger.citation: Archive.org record memoirsremainsof00grey: title "Memoirs and remains of Lady Jane Grey"; creator "Grey, Jane, Lady, 1537-1554", "Nicolas, Nicholas Harris, Sir, 1799-1848"; publisher "London : H. first-letter-to-henry-bullinger.note: Latin original; the edition prints an English "[translation.]" after each letter without naming the translator (presumably the editor, Nicolas). Public domain by the 1831 publication date.

letters-109697-to-trajan-on-the-christia.citation: Georgetown page names no translator. Its text opens "It is my practice, my lord, to refer to you all matters concerning which I am in doubt." Melmoth, rev. Bosanquet (Project Gutenberg #2811, https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/2811) opens "IT is my invariable rule, Sir, to refer to you in all matters where I feel doubtful".
letters-109697-to-trajan-on-the-christia.note: FINDING: the published text is not the Melmoth/Bosanquet translation the notes claim; its translator is unidentified and it may be a modern translation. Copyright review needed.
